markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the person is seen in public.
markets.rules_primary: If James Talarico has been seen in public starting 4:00 PM Oct 8, 2026 and before Oct 9, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
All of the following criteria must be met:

Physical Presence: James Talarico is physically present (not virtual/holographic) and alive
Consciousness: James Talarico appears conscious and aware (not unconscious, comatose, or incapacitated)
Public Setting: The sighting occurs in one of the following:
   A public space accessible to the general public (streets, parks, shops, restaurants)
   A ticketed public event (concerts, sports events, conferences)
   An official public appearance (government events, ceremonies, press conferences)
   A semi-public venue where public access is normal (hotels, airports, train stations)

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:

Pre-recorded or archival footage presented as current
Private events closed to the general public (private parties, closed meetings)
Medical facilities, private residences, or restricted areas
Virtual appearances (video calls, holograms, avatars)
Body doubles or impersonators
Corpses, funeral viewings, or posthumous footage

Examples that WOULD resolve to Yes:

James Talarico attends a movie premiere and is photographed on the red carpet by multiple Source Agencies
James Talarico gives a live press conference covered by news media
James Talarico attends a sporting event and is shown on the stadium's video screens

Examples that would NOT resolve to Yes:

Pre-recorded video message
Private party footage leaked online
Someone claiming to be James Talarico but without Source Agency confirmation
James Talarico appearing via video link from home
markets.title: Will James Talarico be seen in public before Oct 9, 2026?

The return for each cryptocurrency in the specified set is calculated independently over the given time period using the formula: Return = (Ending Price − Starting Price) / Starting Price × 100. The Starting Price and Ending Price are defined as the time-weighted average of the Spot Rate values published by CFBenchmarks during the 60-second intervals immediately preceding the start and end of the time period, respectively. Final returns are calculated on an identical basis for every cryptocurrency in the set and rounded to three decimal places (as a percentage).

position, each tied cryptocurrency's Contract will resolve to "Yes" with a value equal to $1 divided by the number of cryptocurrencies tied for the highest position,
rounded down to the nearest cent, and each remaining (non-tied) cryptocurrency's
Contract will resolve to "No."
